title: Retry deployment using a new canister ID and update frontend to target it

requirements.text: Provision and deploy the app to a new Internet Computer canister ID (i.e., do not reuse the previously deployed canister), so the live site is served from the new canister.

quotes: Can you use another canister ID?

acceptanceCriteria: A new canister ID is created/selected for deployment (different from the previously used one).
The deployment completes successfully without the prior internal build/deploy error.
The app is reachable at the new canister’s icp0.io URL.

requirements.text: Update the frontend canister/agent configuration used by `createActorWithConfig` so the UI talks to the newly deployed backend canister ID after redeploying.

quotes: Can you use another canister ID?

acceptanceCriteria: After deployment, the frontend loads without canister-resolution errors and can create the backend actor successfully.
Any generated canister-ID references used by the frontend are consistent with the newly deployed canister.
No changes are made to the immutable hook files (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`).

requirements.text: If a custom domain is configured for the project, ensure the custom-domain verification file and deployment instructions remain consistent with the new canister deployment (i.e., do not break existing custom domain setup for `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`).

quotes: Can you use another canister ID?

acceptanceCriteria: No regressions are introduced in custom domain configuration documentation (`frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md`).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new quiz features or changing quiz content.
Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Play Store/TWA asset generation or publishing steps (unless required to keep deployment consistent).
